Name: Mitiga Solutions
Description:

Our platform, EarthScanTM, turns the world’s best climate science and AI into decision-ready intelligence.

· Assess exposure to floods, heat stress, wildfires, wind and more
· Analyse single sites or entire portfolios
· Meet disclosure requirements under CSRD (ESRS E1), IFRS S2 / TCFD, and other global standards

· Proprietary algorithms combining climate science, AI and high-performance computing for asset-level precision
· Quantifies uncertainty and provides transparent methodology to support regulatory and investor scrutiny

 Why choose Mitiga
· Regulatory-ready: Audit-ready outputs aligned with leading climate disclosure frameworks
· Asset-level precision: Hazard and impact modelling down to individual assets
· Built for scale: From one location to thousands, with bulk processing and API integration

Mitiga is trusted by global insurers, asset managers, corporates and consultancies to deliver transparent, defensible physical climate risk insights that stand up to regulatory and investor scrutiny.

Name: Sentinella
Description:
Sentinella is a wildfire risk intelligence platform. We turn fire risk uncertainty into precise, daily-updated risk scores at 200×200m resolution.

Sixth-generation fires have broken traditional risk models. Standard indices operate at 8–10km resolution and miss what actually determines where fires burn: the real history of the territory — where, when, and why it has burned before.

We combine 40+ years of national wildfire history, real-time weather data, and satellite imagery to generate a proprietary risk index at 200×200 metres, updated daily. Our resolution is 40× more granular than conventional benchmarks such as the Fire Weather Index.

Who we serve:
— Insurers: accurate wildfire risk pricing, reduced portfolio exposure, lower claims volatility
— Public administrations: evidence-based prevention planning and resource prioritisation
— Asset owners: territorial risk assessment for climate-exposed real estate and infrastructure

No proprietary sensors. No physical infrastructure. Scalable wherever climate risk is critical.

Sentinella is a climate tech spin-off of Regenera Natura. 16,000+ risk cells mapped. 90,000 pilot targets identified. Product live at sentinella.es.

We are not just building wildfire maps. We are building a new intelligence layer for better climate risk decisions, every day.
